# Solomon Smith

> Forward Deployed Engineer for ML and AI systems. Founding Engineer at Recursa AI / CourtRules (Jul 2026 to present), building grounded, fail-closed legal AI. CS senior at CSU San Bernardino, graduating December 2026. Available January 2027. Based in Montclair, CA, open to relocation or remote.

- Site: https://solomonsmith.dev

- GitHub: https://github.com/SolomonSmith-dev
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/solomonsmithdev
- Resume: https://solomonsmith.dev/resume/

## Focus

Python, TypeScript, FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Anthropic SDK, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, RAG (pgvector, ChromaDB, sentence-transformers), eval harnesses, MCP, Redis, Docker, Linux.

## Selected work

Each project has a page at https://solomonsmith.dev/projects/<slug>/ with what it does, why it is hard, and the command or file that reproduces every number.

- [CourtRules judge assistant](https://solomonsmith.dev/projects/courtrules/): retrieval-grounded Q&A over filed court orders on a platform covering 1,653 judges; every quoted claim is verified verbatim before it renders. Product: https://courtrules.app
- [arda](https://solomonsmith.dev/projects/arda/): LangGraph orchestrator on Anthropic tool_use, Redis shell executor, LlamaIndex RAG, MCP server; 577 tests pass offline, labelled injection evals. Source: https://github.com/SolomonSmith-dev/arda
- [soc-triage-ai](https://solomonsmith.dev/projects/soc-triage-ai/): RAG-grounded SOC alert triage with MITRE ATT&CK mapping, a fixed refusal path and a 100-case harness replayed in CI. Source: https://github.com/SolomonSmith-dev/soc-triage-ai
- [sentinel](https://solomonsmith.dev/projects/sentinel/): home-network security monitor (C++ libpcap sensor, Suricata, isolation-forest anomaly score, Cloudflare Workers + D1); 119 vitest, 197 pytest, 4 ctest; private dashboard. Source: https://github.com/SolomonSmith-dev/sentinel
- [phishguard](https://solomonsmith.dev/projects/phishguard/): LightGBM phishing URL classifier (test AUC 0.9943, 1.54% FPR on Tranco top-5,000) with the PhiUSIIL dataset leakage found, fixed and locked by tests. Source: https://github.com/SolomonSmith-dev/phishguard
- [agentic-engineering-os](https://solomonsmith.dev/projects/agentic-engineering-os/): Claude Code workers in sandboxed worktrees, every tool call recorded, draft PR only after an independent reviewer approves; 524 tests. Source: https://github.com/SolomonSmith-dev/agentic-engineering-os
- [DocMind](https://solomonsmith.dev/projects/docmind/): local RAG document Q&A with page-level citations and prompt-injection filtering; 113 tests. Source: https://github.com/SolomonSmith-dev/DocMind
